nwb_bad.Description: Original NWB electrode table field bad; no coordinate or anatomical inference.

nwb_electrode_id.Description: Original NWB electrode table field electrode_id; no coordinate or anatomical inference.

nwb_filtering.Description: Original NWB electrode table field filtering; no coordinate or anatomical inference.

nwb_group.Description: Original NWB electrode table field group; no coordinate or anatomical inference.

nwb_group_name.Description: Original NWB electrode table field group_name; no coordinate or anatomical inference.

nwb_id.Description: Original NWB electrode table field id; no coordinate or anatomical inference.

nwb_imp.Description: Original NWB electrode table field imp; no coordinate or anatomical inference.

nwb_location.Description: Source NWB electrode location label (anatomical label as published; the source collection describes hand-marked anatomical labels). Empty in source -> n/a.

nwb_table_row.Description: Original NWB electrode table field table_row; no coordinate or anatomical inference.

nwb_x.Description: Source NWB electrode table column x ('the x coordinate of the channel location'), unchanged. Frame and units are not documented by the source; n/a where the source value is NaN.

nwb_y.Description: Source NWB electrode table column y ('the y coordinate of the channel location'), unchanged. Frame and units are not documented by the source; n/a where the source value is NaN.

nwb_z.Description: Source NWB electrode table column z ('the z coordinate of the channel location'), unchanged. Frame and units are not documented by the source; n/a where the source value is NaN.
